stage_name_zh: 阶段 3：逻辑写作、消融对比与六级/雅思托福高分论证（Day 51–75）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 27 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G004】冠词系统（a/an, the, 零冠词）与学术特指/泛指边界；【G009】代词指代一致性、比较替代词（that/those of）与消除指代悬空。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP012】显式声明模型假设、研究范围与成立前提，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 冠词系统（a/an, the, 零冠词）与学术特指/泛指边界
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 冠词决定名词短语的指称范围：单数可数泛指用 a/an；指代本研究特定样本/模型（the sample, the model）或带 of 后置限定的属性（the accuracy of the measurements, the nature of the task）用 the；复数可数或不可数表普遍概念用零冠词。
rules: 单数可数名词在句中不可裸奔（bare singular），必须带冠词或限定词（a limitation, the protocol, each trajectory）。
注意冠词改变词义：nature（零冠词）指“大自然”，而 the nature of the problem 指“问题的基本性质”；in charge of（主动负责） vs in the charge of（由他人看管负责）。
图表编号直接作专名指称时不加 the（see Table 1, Figure 2 shows），但普通名词需加冠词（in the table below）。
examples: Equity is an abstract concept that requires an operational definition.
The nature of the task determines which measures are appropriate.
As can be seen in Table 1, the groups differ in size.
common_errors: 单数可数名词漏掉冠词：*We conducted survey / *Trained model achieved lower error。
图表编号前误加冠词：*See the Table 2（应为 See Table 2）。

grammar_instruction.name: 代词指代一致性、比较替代词（that/those of）与消除指代悬空
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 代词必须具有唯一、明确的先行词。学术写作中严禁出现可同时指向多个名词的歧义代词（ambiguous pronoun）或缺乏总结名词的裸奔 this。
rules: 当句中有两个同数名词时，不用裸 it/they/this，应改用 the former / the latter 或 This + 总结性范畴名词（this discrepancy, this constraint, these observations）。
比较结构中必须用 that of 替代前文单数/不可数名词，用 those of 替代前文复数可数名词，确保比较对象同范畴（The cost is low relative to that of the earlier procedure）。
examples: The pronoun makes the final sentence ambiguous.
The cost is low relative to that of the earlier procedure.
These findings differ from those reported in the earlier study.
We compare interviews and surveys; the former allow follow-up questions.
common_errors: 比较结构漏掉 that/those of，导致拿“误差”直接跟“基线模型”相比：*The error of our model is lower than the baseline（应为 lower than that of the baseline）。

grammar_instruction.name: 分词短语（现在分词与过去分词）作后置定语与状语及悬垂修饰防范
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 分词短语能将冗长的从句浓缩为紧凑的后置定语或状语；但句首分词短语的逻辑主语必须与主句主语完全一致，绝不可产生悬垂修饰（Dangling Modifier）。
rules: 后置分词定语：records exceeding the limit (= that exceed...)；predictions compared with ground-truth labels (= that are compared...)。
句首分词状语主语一致铁律：Using a 48-step look-back window, the model reduces MSE（the model 可以 use window；但不能写 *Using a 48-step window, the MSE decreases，因为 MSE 不会自己 use window！）。
examples: Records exceeding the stated size limit were excluded.
Compared with earlier studies, this study used a larger sample.
Halving the sampling interval doubles the sampling frequency.
common_errors: 悬垂分词：*Training on synthetic data, the generalization error remained high（应改为 When the model was trained on synthetic data, ... 或 Training on synthetic data left the model with high generalization error）。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 显式声明模型假设、研究范围与成立前提
expression_pattern_instruction.template: We confine the analysis to [domain/regime]; the bound holds provided that [regularity/stationarity assumption] is satisfied.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于理论推导或实证边界说明，体现科学严谨性。
examples: We confine the analysis to observations collected before the policy change.
A sufficient condition guarantees the stated result when that condition holds.
common_errors: 隐瞒模型成立的强假设。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 章节过渡与Given-New指代衔接（This + 总结名词）
expression_pattern_instruction.template: This [discrepancy/limitation/pattern] motivates our next analysis, where we turn to [next topic] in greater detail.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用 This + 范畴名词总结上句结果并自然开启下一句或下一节。
examples: An anomaly in the sensor readings prompted a check of the calibration procedure.
We now turn to the evaluation criteria.
common_errors: 使用指代不清的裸 This 作主语。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00225 phrase] 按自己的进度（例：Students can work at their own pace before the deadline.）；[V00226 phr.] 按自己的进度（例：Students can complete the optional tasks at their own pace.） | 本条用法约束：own 前人称与主语保持一致。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Students can complete the optional tasks at their own pace.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00227 adv. phrase] 随机地（例：Records were selected at random using a stated procedure.）；[V00228 phr.] 随机地（例：The researcher selected records at random.） | 本条用法约束：不能把方便抽样冒称随机。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Records were selected at random using a stated procedure.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00227 adv. phrase] 随机地（例：Records were selected at random using a stated procedure.）；[V00228 phr.] 随机地（例：The researcher selected records at random.） | 本条用法约束：必须符合实际抽样设计；便利抽样不宜如此称呼。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The researcher selected records at random.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：空间或时间位置，通常接of。
key_collocations: at the end of the report
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The limitations appear at the end of the report.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：at，不用 in the moment 表达此义。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The archive is unavailable at the moment.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00231 adv. phrase] 同时；与此同时（例：The policy may improve access; at the same time, its costs require review.）；[V00232 状语短语] 同时；与此同时（例：The number of participants increased; at the same time, costs fell.） | 本条用法约束：可表并列限定，不必指钟表同一时刻。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The policy may improve access; at the same time, its costs require review.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00231 adv. phrase] 同时；与此同时（例：The policy may improve access; at the same time, its costs require review.）；[V00232 状语短语] 同时；与此同时（例：The number of participants increased; at the same time, costs fell.） | 本条用法约束：可表示时间并行，也可补充需要兼顾的另一点。
key_collocations: at the same time, costs fell
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The number of participants increased; at the same time, costs fell.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00233 adv. phrase] 在此处；到这一步（例：At this point, we consider a competing explanation.）；[V00234 phrase] 在这一阶段（例：At this point, the interpretation remains uncertain.） | 本条用法约束：指论证位置或过程阶段，需上下文明确。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: At this point, we consider a competing explanation.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00233 adv. phrase] 在此处；到这一步（例：At this point, we consider a competing explanation.）；[V00234 phrase] 在这一阶段（例：At this point, the interpretation remains uncertain.） | 本条用法约束：教材B脚注中为at this stage的近义变体。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: At this point, the interpretation remains uncertain.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：亦可 at this point。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: At this stage, no conclusion can be drawn.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：attach A to B；具体认证要求须查机构规定。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Please attach the certified translation to your application.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：attempt为名词，at接名词或动名词，表示尝试做某事；也可用an attempt to do。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The report is an attempt at integrating two approaches.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：attend a lecture 是出席；attend to 指留心/处理。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The designer attended to accessibility issues.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：描述注意力转移；wander 不等于 wonder。
